items.title: PH Q3 CY2026 deep dive: Filtration Group integration and broad-based demand drive guidance upgrade
items.summary: Industrial machinery company Parker-Hannifin (NYSE:PH) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027) results topping the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 17.9% year on year to $5.99 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.90 per share was 8.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
